image_description: A close-up view of a car wheel attached to a silver vehicle. The wheel features a five-spoke alloy rim with a two-tone finish (black and machined silver). A black rubber tire is mounted on the rim, showing visible tread patterns and sidewall details. The central hub contains a logo and lug nuts. The wheel is situated within the wheel well of the car, with part of the fender and side skirt visible.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The sidewall lettering/markings are indistinct and slightly 'mushy' rather than sharp raised rubber, which is common in AI generation but not a catastrophic failure. It lacks the crispness of a real macro photo.

artifact_observations.location: Lower left junction of tire and ground/fender
artifact_observations.reasoning: The contact patch where the tire meets the ground is somewhat ambiguous. The shadow is soft, and the bottom edge of the tire blends slightly into the asphalt texture without a hard, weight-bearing compression line.

Reflections on the machined faces of the spokes are slightly inconsistent with the single light source implied by the car body highlights, appearing somewhat generic rather than reflecting the specific environment.

Realism of the contact patch (shadow and compression)
Consistency of reflections on metallic surfaces
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'contact patch' at the bottom of the tire. AI often fails to render the slight flattening of the tire against the ground. Also, inspect the lug nuts in the center; ensure they are geometrically consistent and not just textured blobs. Check if the brake caliper behind the spokes looks structurally plausible or if it melts into the background.
